title: Use the actual conserved sector rather than infer positivity from fugacity
statement: At separately fixed n,n, h_n(B)h_n(B*)=|h_n(B)|²>=0 is a finite polynomial, valid for defective/nonnormal B. Newton recursion n h_n=sum_(k=1..n) Tr(B^k)h_(n-k) avoids an eigenvector assumption. Fixed totalN is different: B=i,B*=-i gives coefficient-1 atN2, versus balanced1,1 weight1.

requires: Finite sites M,populations n and slices L; beta>0, Hermitian K/conjugate flavor hopping, U1>=0,U2<=0, Delta=0 and separately conserved equal populations. The two-mode pole obstruction needs U1>0,U2<0 and uncut Fock space. Fixed-sector input is a different ensemble.

assumptions: A fixed particle sector changes the divergent GC object; finite polynomial positivity is not an efficient-sampling theorem.
